claims.assertion: Gosia presents a staged benevolent Federation encounter as a possible false-invasion scenario that could trade aid for imposed rules.

claims.speaker: Aneeka of Temmer and Ari, as quoted by Gosia

claims.assertion: Ari describes a false invasion as a last resort after other agendas; Gosia reports no near-term face-to-face contact plans from Mari.
claims.speaker: Ari and Mari, as quoted by Gosia
